steps.label: check
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && { echo '== apps'; ls /Applications | grep -i -E 'blender' ; echo '== version'; B=$(ls -d /Applications/Blender*.app 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "$B"; "$B/Contents/MacOS/Blender" --version 2>&1 | head -3; echo '== gpu'; system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'Chipset|Metal|Cores|VRAM'; sysctl -n machdep.cpu.brand_string hw.memsize; echo '== blenderkit'; ls -d "$HOME/blenderkit_data" 2>&1; du -sh "$HOME/blenderkit_data" 2>/dev/null; ls "$HOME/blenderkit_data" 2>/dev/null | head; echo fertig; } > blender_check.res 2>&1; cat blender_check.res
